import ctypes

# Load libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the taus113_state_t structure
class Taus113State(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("z1", ctypes.c_uint),
        ("z2", ctypes.c_uint),
        ("z3", ctypes.c_uint),
        ("z4", ctypes.c_uint)
    ]

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(Taus113State)
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

gsl.gsl_rng_set.restype = None
gsl.gsl_rng_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(Taus113State), ctypes.c_ulong]

gsl.gsl_rng_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_rng_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(Taus113State)]

gsl.gsl_rng_free.restype = None
gsl.gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(Taus113State)]

# Get the taus113 RNG type
gsl.gsl_rng_taus2 = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_taus2")

def generate_random_double(seed):
    """Generates a random double precision number using GSL taus113 RNG."""
    # Allocate the RNG
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_taus2)
    if not rng:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate RNG state.")

    try:
        # Set the seed
        gsl.gsl_rng_set(rng, seed)

        # Generate a random double
        random_value = gsl.gsl_rng_uniform(rng)
        return random_value
    finally:
        # Free the RNG state
        gsl.gsl_rng_free(rng)

def assert_test():
    """Test cases to validate the implementation."""
    # Test with a specific seed
    seed = 12345
    random_value = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0.0 <= random_value < 1.0, "Random value must be between 0 and 1"

    # Test with another seed
    seed = 67890
    random_value = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0.0 <= random_value < 1.0, "Random value must be between 0 and 1"

    # Test with edge case seed (0)
    seed = 0
    random_value = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0.0 <= random_value < 1.0, "Random value must be between 0 and 1"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
